notablePrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Ley Weaver
easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.
